limits: Exact native pufferA / enBlowFishA / renderer 121509 source assignment only; no sibling renderer, chassis, or material route is credited by this record.
The ordinary no-focus hit reduced health from 58 to 48; death used the explicit KillSingle fixture and is not ordinary lethal-damage evidence.
Eighteen selected original PNGs were reviewed; the remaining 342 captured frames and generated videos are retained evidence but were not individually reviewed.

The native direct-death path hides enBlowFishA between reviewed frames 23 and 27 and replaces it with smoke and debris, so this archive accepts a clean hide-and-effect handoff without claiming a visible articulated corpse pose.

The causal Damaged and Death impact frames are strongly occluded by the foreground hero and bright effects; the visible target contour remains continuous, and no sampled tearing, missing surface, fin separation, or viewport clipping was observed.

Indirect death, other native attack variants, portrait, collision, extended culling, long-session resource lifetime, full campaign completion, and final art-direction approval remain outside this archive.
